protocol_deviation: User explicitly replaced the proposed user-completed review with a single ChatGPT AI review. This is a qualitative diagnostic, not independent human evidence or model performance.
blinding_scope: Method names were withheld during case decisions. Prior aggregate project findings were already visible; this is not an independent or double-blind study.
rubric: Compare how useful the full supplied positive/negative pair is for the named rule and the query communicative act.
Prefer behavior, actor relationship, direction, conditionality and use-versus-discussion relevance over shared topic words alone.
Preserve supplied demonstration labels even when their apparent boundary is ambiguous; do not assign a query target.
Choose unclear when missing context or inadequate demonstrations prevent a defensible comparison; tie when utility is comparable.
Ratings are diagnostic preferences, not correctness labels, calibrated confidence, training targets or measured AUC.
post_review_restriction: Do not use these judgments as training labels or loosen any model promotion gate. Do not infer an ensemble or per-query selector from these preferences.
